div.head: Hn mon 1
div.ab: Sciatis quod volo et praecipio, ut omnes burgenses et omnes illi qui in burgis morantur, tam Franci quam Angli, iurent tenere et servare monetam meam in Anglia, ut non consentiant falsitatem monetae meae.

Be it known to you that I desire and enjoin, that all burgesses and all those, both French and English, who dwell in boroughs shall swear so to maintain and preserve my money in England that they will countenance no falsification of my money.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 284–285 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
